top_signals.title: Viking Yachts Tests AI Whale Detection Technology Aboard 70 Convertible
top_signals.summary: Viking Yacht Company is evaluating WhaleSpotter, an artificial intelligence (AI) whale detection system, aboard its new Viking 70 Convertible demonstration vessel. The technology uses thermal imaging and AI to identify whales ahead of moving vessels…
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Army fields new system for sweeping munitions planning, management
top_signals.summary: The service expects this first increment of TACTMIS to replace the previously used TAMIS system once it retires on Oct. 30.
